label: Bug fix
title: Bug fix: establish the reproduction steps first
context: Observed symptoms, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, relevant versions and logs.
verify: The problem no longer occurs with the same steps, and related user flows still work.
trim: For a narrow bug, do not start with broad architectural changes or several review agents.
artifact: Cause → change → execution evidence → unverified scope

label: System migration
title: System migration: separate behavior to preserve from behavior to change
context: Existing contracts and real examples, compatibility scope and intentional behavior changes.
verify: Compare before-and-after results for identical inputs, including errors, permissions, data and performance. Connect differences to intent.
trim: Divide the work into reviewable user flows instead of replacing everything at once.
artifact: Behavior comparison + intentional differences + evidence from the actual environment

label: State and concurrency
title: State and concurrency: connect stated properties to actual code
context: States, events, transitions, forbidden states and concurrency assumptions.
verify: Check the conditions and scope of model exploration or proofs, and the correspondence with code. Reproduce counterexamples as real flows.
trim: Focus on costly races and core states instead of formalizing all the code.
artifact: State diagram + checked properties and scope + code correspondence + runtime observations

label: UI change
title: UI change: judge it through real user flows
context: Representative data, empty, failure and loading states, device sizes and action sequences.
verify: Check input, navigation, saving and resulting data in a real browser. Also check keyboard use and narrow screens.
trim: Distinguish a static mockup from verified functionality. Do not infer working data integration from screenshots alone.
artifact: Before-and-after screens + action sequence + actual results + checked viewport sizes

label: Long-running work
title: Long-running work: use units that can be handed off
context: The goal, settled decisions, current revision, dependencies, and time and cost budgets.
verify: Acceptance criteria and execution results for each unit. Track completed and unverified work separately.
trim: Avoid repeated interviews when no major decision needs discussion. Do not repeat every step across several models.
artifact: Progress record + evidence by revision + next action + stopping conditions

label: Learning a new area
title: Learning a new area: assess output and understanding separately
context: Your current understanding, an example to try, suspected causes and what you do not yet know.
verify: Read the code and explain input → state → result. Predict what would fail if the conditions changed.
trim: Ask for the reasoning behind important decisions and small examples, not just finished code.
artifact: Your explanation + actual evidence + incorrect assumptions + the next exercise
